apparatus.crit: yad atrādya tad bhavān vaktum arhati
pitary uparate cāpi kr̥taśaucaḥ sa bhārata
evaṃ sa bahuśo rājan purodhasam upāhasat
vyāyāmaḥ karkaśatvaṃ ca vīryaṃ ca puruṣe guṇāḥ
akṣayaṃ ca kulaṃ te ’stu maharṣibhir alaṃkr̥tam
purā kr̥tayuge tāta r̥ṣir āsīn mahāyaśāḥ
gāyadbhir nr̥tyamānaiś ca utpatadbhir itas tataḥ vr̥taṃ
yat kiṃ cid bhagavāṃs tad asaṃśayam
etat pr̥thivyām amr̥tam etac cakṣur anuttamam
idam antaram ity evaṃ tato ’bhyāgād athāśramam
sā hi putrasamā rājan vihitā kurunandana
tau tu dr̥ṣṭvā taṃ tad āścaryaṃ
yad yad brūyān munis tat tat sarvaṃ
atīva hy atra muhyāmi cintayāno divāniśam
evam astv iti dharmātmā tadā bharatasattama
pitr̥̄n devān r̥ṣīn viprān atithīṃś ca
sa śatrūṇām upari ca saṃtiṣṭhati yudhiṣṭhira
kuryān; mr̥dur dāntaś cātitheyaś ca nityam vr̥ttiṃ viprāyātisr̥jeta
mokṣahetur abhūt kr̥ṣṇas tad apy avadhr̥taṃ
hy abhisaṃstuvaṃś ca gā vai nr̥padhuri
duḥkham āśramāś ca sudurvidāḥ parivāreṇa vai
piṇḍo deyo nareṇeha tato matir abhūn mama
tatas tasmāt kiṃ cit tatrāpatad bhuvi
ity uktvā punar evāgnim anusasrur divaukasaḥ
vāruṇās te ’py udāhr̥tāḥ br̥haspatir utathyaś ca vayasyaḥ
tilair vrīhiyavair māṣair adbhir mūlaphalais tathā
cid vicarantas te vr̥kṣair aviralair vr̥tām
etasmāt kāraṇād brahmaṃś ciram etat kr̥taṃ
mahātmanāsmi; buddhas tasmāt prītimāṃs te ’ham adya
saṃsāracakram āsādya kr̥miyonau prajāyate kr̥mir bhavati
kr̥tvā karmāṇi pāpāni kathaṃ yānti śubhāṃ gatim
śrūyate na sa māṃ hanyād iti tasmād apākrame
adan hy avidvān hanty annam adyamānaṃ
buddhir īdr̥śī loko hy ayaṃ guṇān eva bhūyiṣṭhaṃ sma praśaṃsati
puṇyam etat tapaś caiva svargaś caiṣa
ity uktas tv arjunas tūṣṇīm abhūd vāyus tam abravīt
ity uktas tv arjunas tūṣṇīm abhūd vāyus tam abravīt
rathas tricakras; trivr̥cchirāś caturasraś ca tasya
kiṃ cid; viṣvaksenāt sarvam etat pratīhi
